summary.zh: 按仓库问答生成结构说明
summary.en: Ask questions about any GitHub repository

description.zh: 针对公开 GitHub 仓库回答架构、模块划分与实现细节，回答附带源码位置。适合接手陌生项目或弄清某个依赖库的用法。无需授权，填好地址即可连接。
description.en: Answer questions about architecture, module layout, and implementation details of public GitHub repositories, with pointers into the source. Good for onboarding onto an unfamiliar project or understanding a dependency. No sign-in required; connect with the URL alone.

authHint.zh: 无需授权，填好地址即可连接
authHint.en: No sign-in needed, connect with the URL
